title: Novel technique based on Léja Points Approximation for Log-determinant Estimation of Large matrices
summary: The computation of the Log-determinant of large, sparse, symmetric positive definite (SPD) matrices is essential in many scientific computational fields such as numerical linear algebra and machine learning. In low dimensions, Cholesky is preferred, but in high dimensions, its computation may be prohibitive due to memory limitation. To circumvent this, Krylov subspace techniques have proven to be efficient but may be computationally expensive due to the required orthogonalization processes.
